A clear, compassionate practice for adults facing change and overwhelm

I combine evidence-informed therapy with reflective practices to help you build steady habits, calm your nervous system, and find meaningful direction. Therapy is collaborative, confidential, and paced to fit your life.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}
  • {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}

  • {{EMAIL}}

Therapist: {{THERAPIST_NAME}} — modalities: {{MODALITIES}}

A gentle diagnostic to clarify what you need

No labels, just a brief set of prompts that helps us map priorities for therapy. Use this to get clarity before booking.

Quick check (3–5 min)

Suggested path

Complete the short check to receive a suggested starting plan. This is not a clinical diagnosis and does not replace urgent care.

A scaffolded plan to build steadiness

I offer time-limited cohort programs and individual sessions so you can try a structure first, then transition into longer-term work if it fits.

Foundation Path — "Begin Again"

8-week introductory cohort. Small group with weekly live sessions and 1:1 check-ins.

  • Guided psychoeducation
  • Reflective journaling prompts
  • Practical emotion regulation tools

A low-cost entryway to therapy skills and community.

Core Support — individual sessions

Flexible weekly or biweekly sessions tailored to your priorities.

  • Individualized treatment plan
  • Homework rooted in daily life
  • Coordination with other providers as needed

Recommended when your needs are specific or complex.

Intensive Short-Term — "Reset Sprint"

4-week focused option for pressing transitions.

  • Twice-monthly sessions
  • Consolidated skills practice

Ideal for people needing momentum within a short window.

Micro-habits that compound

Small practices you can try between sessions to reduce reactivity and build trust with yourself.

  • Two-minute grounding

    Feet on the floor, three slow breaths, name three things in the room.

  • Weekly check-in

    One paragraph noting what improved and what felt hard.

  • Boundary script

    Practice one simple phrase to say no or set a limit.

Fees & enrollment options

I offer a mix of cohort pricing and individual rates to increase access. Sliding scale openings are limited; please inquire.

Foundation Cohort

$350 cohort fee

Includes weekly group sessions + one 30-min check-in.

Individual session

$150 / 50 minutes

Insurance: I work with clients using out-of-network benefits. Receipts provided.

Reset Sprint

$500 / 4 weeks

Short-term focused support with structured practices between sessions.

Payments, cancellation policy, and sliding scale terms are discussed at intake. Insurance reimbursement is client responsibility.

Ready to take a small next step?

I offer a brief intake conversation to see if we're a fit. Confidential and collaborative — you remain in control.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Message me

{{BUSINESS_NAME}} — {{THERAPIST_NAME}}, {{LICENSE}}

All contact is held in strict confidence except where safety concerns require disclosure. This site does not provide emergency services. If you are in crisis, contact local emergency services or your crisis line.
